standard_prerequisites.use: The naive cotangent complex of a morphism, etale localization of differentials, and etale charts for algebraic spaces; the comparison is retained.

core_obligations: Choose a surjective etale chart and form the corresponding morphism of schemes.
Construct the comparison map between the two naive cotangent complexes and verify it is an isomorphism on each term.

proof_roadmap.step: Choose an etale chart and set up the corresponding morphism of schemes.
Identify the degree-zero terms using the etale-local description of differentials.
Construct and check the comparison map on both terms of the complex.

difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the naive cotangent complex of a morphism of algebraic spaces with the naive cotangent complex of a morphism of etale scheme charts, which is what makes the naive cotangent complex computable in practice. The proof chooses a surjective etale chart, forms the associated morphism of schemes, uses the earlier identification of the sheaf of differentials in the etale-local situation, and then compares the two-term complexes by constructing the comparison map and checking it is an isomorphism on each term. Recovering the comparison for the complex from the identification for the differentials is the step that is not formal. Retained author proof at lines 5336-5395.
